node_labels.Chunk: A retrievable passage within a document
node_labels.Organization: A named company, institution, or group
node_labels.Tool: A named technology, product, framework, or service
node_labels.Project: A named initiative, application, or system
node_labels.Resource: A named external asset, publication, dataset, or reference

relationship_types.PART_OF: A chunk belongs to a document
relationship_types.DISCUSSES: A chunk substantively discusses an entity
relationship_types.MENTIONS: A source explicitly mentions an entity
relationship_types.RELATED_TO: Two knowledge entities are meaningfully related
relationship_types.USES: A project or tool uses another entity
relationship_types.CREATED_BY: An entity was created by a person or organization
relationship_types.WORKS_AT: A person is affiliated with an organization
relationship_types.REFERENCES: A source points to another entity
relationship_types.DEPENDS_ON: An entity depends on another entity
relationship_types.APPLIES: A project or resource applies a concept or tool
relationship_types.BUILT_ON: A tool or project is built on another tool
